items.q: “the collection of firms that convert raw materials into chemical products” is the definition of
o: chemical industry
yield
unit operation
flowsheet
items.s: chemical industry is the collection of firms that convert raw materials into chemical products.

items.q: employment generation may be defined as
o: the money kept in the country by manufacturing instead of importing
the creation of jobs by manufacturing activity
the increase in worth of a material when it is processed
the share of a project supplied by local firms and labour
items.s: employment generation: the creation of jobs by manufacturing activity. The other options describe local content, foreign exchange saving, value addition.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines feedstock?
o: the calcium sulphate mineral used to control the setting of cement
the stated set of properties a material must meet
the principal raw material supplied to a chemical process
the calcium carbonate rock used in cement and in lime manufacture
items.s: feedstock: the principal raw material supplied to a chemical process. The other options describe gypsum, limestone, specification.

items.q: The correct meaning of unit process is
o: a single physical step in a process such as distillation or filtration
the sequence of operations that turns raw materials into product
the share of the reacted material that becomes the wanted product
a single chemical step in a process such as oxidation or nitration
items.s: unit process: a single chemical step in a process such as oxidation or nitration. The other options describe unit operation, selectivity, process.

items.q: crystallisation may be defined as
o: distillation that separates several components by their boiling points
separation of a solid from a liquid by passing through a medium
the formation of solid crystals from a solution
the removal of solvent as vapour to concentrate a solution
items.s: crystallisation: the formation of solid crystals from a solution. The other options describe evaporation, fractional distillation, filtration.

items.q: The correct meaning of paint industry is

the plant that separates crude oil into useful fractions
the sector manufacturing coatings from pigments, binders and solvents
the plant that manufactures nitrogen, phosphorus or potassium fertilisers
items.s: paint industry: the sector manufacturing coatings from pigments, binders and solvents. The other options describe fertiliser plant, refinery, soap and detergent industry.

items.q: The correct meaning of flammable is
o: able to cause harm when taken into the body
the rendering safe of waste before it is released
the ventilated enclosure in which harmful vapours are handled
able to catch fire easily at ordinary temperatures
items.s: flammable: able to catch fire easily at ordinary temperatures. The other options describe waste treatment, toxic, fume cupboard.

items.q: In this course, infrastructure refers to
o: the power, water, roads and services factories depend on
the growth of manufacturing within an economy
the creation of jobs by manufacturing activity
the total expense of making a product
items.s: infrastructure: the power, water, roads and services factories depend on. The other options describe cost of production, employment generation, industrialisation.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines petrochemical?
o: the plant that produces cement from limestone and clay
a chemical made from petroleum or natural gas
the plant that manufactures nitrogen, phosphorus or potassium fertilisers
the plant that separates crude oil into useful fractions
items.s: petrochemical: a chemical made from petroleum or natural gas. The other options describe fertiliser plant, refinery, cement plant.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines flammable?
o: a substance that supplies oxygen and can make fire spread fiercely
the liquid waste discharged from a process
able to catch fire easily at ordinary temperatures
the document giving the hazards, handling and first aid for a chemical
items.s: flammable: able to catch fire easily at ordinary temperatures. The other options describe safety data sheet, oxidising agent, effluent.

items.q: “the total expense of making a product” is the definition of

supply chain
cost of production
employment generation
items.s: cost of production is the total expense of making a product.

corrosive
flammable
personal protective equipment
items.s: safety data sheet is the document giving the hazards, handling and first aid for a chemical.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines titration?
o: the measurement of concentration by adding a reagent of known strength
the checking of an instrument against a known standard
the change made to stop a fault from happening again
the written instruction for carrying out a task the same way every time
items.s: titration: the measurement of concentration by adding a reagent of known strength. The other options describe standard operating procedure, calibration, corrective action.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains quality control.
o: the system that ensures quality is built in rather than only checked
the failure of a product or process to meet a stated requirement
the checking of product against specification during and after manufacture
the measurement of concentration by adding a reagent of known strength
items.s: quality control: the checking of product against specification during and after manufacture. The other options describe titration, non conformity, quality assurance.

safety data sheet
personal protective equipment

o: the plant that separates crude oil into useful fractions
the sector manufacturing coatings from pigments, binders and solvents
the sector manufacturing medicines to defined standards
the sector manufacturing cleansing products from oils and chemicals
